function.name: get_protein
function.description: Look up a protein record by UniProt accession (e.g. P04637). Returns accession, protein_name, gene_symbol, organism, length (amino acids), mass (Da) and subcellular_location. Every record includes a _verification field computed by a deterministic checker against the full database entry (sequence/formula recount, taxonomy, reverse lookup); it lists any field whose value could not be confirmed, with the derived value where one exists.

function.name: find_protein_by_gene
function.description: Look up the human (Homo sapiens) protein encoded by a gene symbol (e.g. TP53). Returns the same record fields as get_protein. Every record includes a _verification field computed by a deterministic checker against the full database entry (sequence/formula recount, taxonomy, reverse lookup); it lists any field whose value could not be confirmed, with the derived value where one exists.
